FlipOS vendored dependency

Project:
gambatte-libretro

Upstream:
https://github.com/libretro/gambatte-libretro.git

Vendored upstream commit:
d9d6cd06382d1ced30de34d56d3609452323dab1

Upstream branch at time of vendoring:
master

This source is vendored into the FlipOS repository so that FlipOS builds
against a known, reproducible Gambatte revision.

Do not update this dependency without testing the new revision on real
Miyoo Flip hardware.
